summary: AstroNova, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting shareholder approval of its merger with Orion Merger Parent, Inc. Under the Merger Agreement dated June 16, 2026, AstroNova will become a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent, with each outstanding share (except excluded shares) converted into $29.00 per share in cash. The special meeting held August 25, 2026 saw 5,027,868 votes for, 4,693 against, and 5,467 abstentions. The deal, a cash acquisition taking the company private, requires regulatory and other customary closing conditions. Watch for completion timing and any further regulatory hurdles.
